note: Which channels may use the premium engine and how. No workflow reads this file: the premium engine is an offline, manually invoked path. A channel's normal production pipeline (portfolio-production.yml, uretim.yml), its schedule, topics and voice approvals are unchanged by it. Changing a mode here never publishes anything; publication stays with the existing pipeline and its gates.

modes.offline-review: premium plans and renders may be produced offline; every result needs the contract's human approvals and is never auto-published
modes.not-available: no premium channel pack exists for this channel; it keeps its existing production path; other channels' templates must not be used

failure-reconstructed.remakesOfPublishedTopics: owner approval required per video (Challenger, Apollo 13: evaluation only)

impossible-brief.note: ImpossibleBrief keeps its own visual identity and existing pipeline. The FR engineering/forensic templates are not allowed for it; an IB pack (cinematic what-if grammar) would be a separate, approved project.
